title: Overcock
description: Changes all instances of the word "overclock" in the mod GregTechCEu Modern
body:
# Can you not enjoy your game without mentions of Roosters?
me neither. i made this anyway. 

**all mentions of overclocking inside of the mod have been replaced with "overcocking"!** enjoy dying of laugher as your game starts filling to the brim with this unbearable joke.
~~it took me 2 minutes to make this, whoever you are, if you are reading this, know that i've never played gregtech.~~

hope you like it, i know i am definetly ambiguous towards it morally.
